page.overview:
Who is Roman Dunes?

Roman Dunes is the crew chief for the racing team "No Stall" in the movie Cars.

"A former National Guard rapid deployment specialist, Chief No Stall takes no chances with his crew's safety! Known as the toughest crew chief on the circuit, he barks out orders so loudly that No Stall race car Todd Marcus could swear he can hear his directions on the track with or without the radio."
